title: Ansel and the Oath
author: Elodie Nakamura
blurb: Isandro Nakamura, a thief who steals memories, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
